items.item: `Tests/Linter Rule Structure Tests/Lint.License.Header Tests.swift`: `manifest tools directive is pre
items.reason: The existing test has a blank line between directive and header, so by reading it passes already; the defect is the no-blank-line case. recognize(in:) now makes a first-line `// swift-tools-version:` directive its own block; new test covers the directive directly above the header.

Check moved toward the message syntactically: instance stored properties whose annotated type mentions Unsafe*Pointer, OpaquePointer, Unmanaged, AnyObject or a non-@Sendable function type exempt the struct; message names that exemption. Properties without a type annotation are assumed Sendable (syntax can't tell).

notes: New internal SyntaxVisitor MemoryNonSendableStorageTypeFinder in its own file. Stored properties with willSet/didSet are treated as computed by the reused helper memoryStructSendableClassMemberIsComputed, so they are not inspected. Could not confirm the 'CI red on main' claim locally.
